value.title: Close a build pod's step
value.summary: Before `pij pod down` closes the build pod's seats: the step's worktree holds nothing uncommitted and its branch has no open PR. Either one stopping stops the down, which closes nothing (a brake; `pij pod down <pod> --skip-close-procedure` goes on anyway).

value.who: `pij pod down` runs it in the caller's process; anyone may run a step by hand.
value.when: At pod down, with key pod-<pod>. A pod with no work-folder has nothing to check, and both steps pass.

value.fix: run it with --key pod-<pod>; `pij pod down <pod>` does

value.title: Nothing is left uncommitted
value.done_when: The pod's work-folder has no uncommitted or untracked change (or the pod records none).

value.title: The step's PR is settled
value.done_when: No open PR has the work-folder's branch as its head (or the pod records no folder).

sections.name: done_when
sections.value: The step's work is committed and its PR merged or closed, so closing the pod's seats loses nothing.

value.text: Step 0002 asks GitHub through `gh`; without `gh` or its login it stops with that fix.
Skipping it with --skip-close-procedure while the PR is still open: the seats close and their context goes with them.

value.guarantees: The shipped build pod's close procedure.
